title: Household Rescheduling Amounts — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Rate card, Specimen Collection Appointments — late changes to a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit with household members booked.**

When one or more additional household members are booked on the visit (as the visit record shows them), a late change carries a household rescheduling amount, an amount added to the late-change charge:

- a change recorded **the day before** the appointment date is charged **per person booked: 5.00 for the patient and 5.00 for each member**;
- a change recorded **on the appointment date itself** is charged **once per visit, 24.00** whatever the number of people booked, which is never less than the day-before amount for a household of up to three members;
- a visit with no household member booked carries no household rescheduling amount.

The day is counted in calendar days from today to the current appointment date.

## Cases (hypothetical visits)

| Additional household members booked | Change recorded | People booked | Household rescheduling amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The day before | 2 | 10.00 |
| 3 | The day before | 4 | 20.00 |
| 3 | On the appointment date | 4 | 24.00 |
| 1 | On the appointment date | 2 | 24.00 |
| 0 | Either day | 1 | None |
